text: Based on the evidence, the asset has experienced deforestation after the 2020 baseline, totaling **87.4 ha of tree-cover loss (2.4% of the asset)** between 2021 and 2023. The largest event (81.3 ha in 2021) was corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference data, meeting the EUDR’s requirement for evidence of forest loss. Since the EUDR prohibits products linked to deforestation after December 31, 2020, this asset **does not comply** with EUDR regulations due to post-baseline deforestation.
